key_insight: A general-purpose AI agent combines materials data, predictive models and reaction networks to turn plain-language questions into testable synthesis plans.
engineering_relevance: The workflow links material screening to practical experimental choices, including precursors, crucibles and atmosphere.
method: Connect the agent to Alexandria calculations, crystal-generation models and property predictors.
Use a reaction graph to assess synthesis energetics and reject weakly driven routes.
Propose candidate materials and experiments, then challenge candidates with newly generated structures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports about 15 million DFT calculations and a graph of 17.4 billion reactions, with unattended case studies producing proposals beyond a web-search-only baseline.
watch_item: The abstract describes computational proposals, not laboratory validation; predicted stability and synthesis feasibility still require experimental confirmation.
paper_title: Materials research with a general-purpose agent
